steps.summary: Thirteen font sizes and four weights became five sizes and two weights, so headings are found by size and every label, figure and timestamp belongs to a named role.

changes.what: Font sizes on the page, collapsed onto a ladder of named roles
Font weights in use, and the font request trimmed to match
The page title becomes the last step of the breadcrumb in the header bar
changes.before: 22px / 600 h1 under a 12.5px breadcrumb, two lines
changes.after: 13px / 500 on one line: Fieldnote / app.fieldnote.io / Overview

changes.what: Headline figures stop outweighing their labels
Section headings one size up, found by size and tracking rather than boldness
Sidebar group labels keep their capitals, on the ladder's size and weight, with no rule
changes.after: ANALYTICS — 12px / 500 / uppercase / +0.06em, parted by space alone

changes.what: Page paths in the text face instead of monospace boxes
changes.before: monospace 12.5px / 500; feed paths in bordered code boxes
changes.after: Inter 13px with a slashed zero; no boxes

changes.what: A metric-matched fallback so the font swap doesn't move text
changes.after: "Inter Fallback": Arial at size-adjust 107.12%, ascent 90.44%, descent 22.52%

steps.summary: Captions and timestamps became readable, the search field and the comparison line got edges you can see, and the brand colour stayed everywhere it had a job — the selected nav item carries a little more of it, as a tint.

changes.what: Timestamps, captions, axis labels and placeholders became readable
Dark-theme captions clear the product's 4.8:1 target on hovered rows
The search field gets an edge you can find
The previous-period line can be seen
Green change chips reach text contrast
The current nav item sits on an accent tint inside the 10–15% the law sets
The 61.3% bounce rate no longer relies on red alone
changes.after: a red chip with an alert glyph and screen-reader text

changes.what: The table's view bars run in the brand colour at full strength

steps.summary: Nine boxes became three: the figures are one strip, the chart sits on the page, the table keeps one frame and the activity feed stays a card beside them, under a slimmer header bar.

changes.what: Bordered regions on the screen
changes.before: 9 (4 figure tiles, 3 section cards, 2 sidebar panels)
changes.after: 3 (activity rail, table frame, workspace switcher) plus the usage panel

changes.what: Headline figures become one strip parted by hairlines
changes.before: 4 tiles, each with a 12px radius, border and shadow, 16px apart

changes.what: A hairline parts the figures from the sections below, and the chart from the table
changes.after: 0.5px full-bleed under the figure strip; 0.5px between chart and table, as wide as their column and short of the activity card; 32px either side

changes.what: The header bar slims down; date range and bell become quiet ghost buttons
changes.after: 52px tall, one 34px field with an edge, two borderless 34px buttons

changes.what: Spacing on named roles, with headings closer to what they introduce
changes.before: no spacing tokens; 20px between sections, 18px under headings (1.1 : 1)
changes.after: 8 / 16 / 32px tokens; 32px above a section heading, 12px below (2.7 : 1)

changes.what: Four chip styles become one
Breakpoints named for what changes, and measured on the content panel
changes.after: 3: bp.shell 860px on the window; bp.rail 860px and bp.compact 560px on the panel

changes.what: A skip link and a z-index ladder
changes.before: no skip link; z-index 5, 20, 30, 40, 50 as literals
changes.after: skip link to #main; 6 named rungs from 10 to 100

changes.what: Corners nest: the workspace avatar shares its switcher's curve
changes.before: 7px avatar in a 10px switcher with 8px padding
changes.after: 6px avatar in a 12px switcher with 6px padding

changes.what: Rounded corners drawn as squircles, so cards, fields and buttons read soft rather than boxy
changes.after: superellipse(1.5) corners at the same 8/12px radii; pills and circles stay round

steps.summary: Shadows came off everything that sits in the page, the header stopped being frosted glass, and the menu and tooltip share one floating recipe that lifts properly in dark mode.

changes.what: Shadows on things that sit in the page
changes.before: 7 shadowed cards and tiles plus 5 shadowed controls

changes.what: The header bar becomes opaque
One floating shadow, softer, with its edge as a ring
The date menu and tooltip lift above the page in dark mode
The tooltip drops the contact shadow of a resting surface
The mobile navigation scrim says modal in both themes and gives focus back
changes.before: 40% in light and dark; focus lost when closed by tapping it
changes.after: 40% light, 60% dark; focus returns to the menu button

steps.summary: Durations moved onto one ladder with one curve, and reduced motion now swaps each animation for a quieter version instead of switching everything off.

changes.what: Durations on a ladder set by how much of the screen changes
One curve for movement; colour never overshoots
changes.before: default ease, ease-out and ease mixed
changes.after: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) for movement, ease-out for colour

changes.what: The navigation sheet closes faster than it opens
Reduced motion keeps the signal and drops the travel
changes.before: every transition and animation switched off
changes.after: menu fades without its 4px drop; sheet fades instead of sliding 248px

changes.what: Press feedback lands on pointer-down
changes.after: a pressed wash at 0ms on nav rows and buttons

steps.summary: The words were already in good shape: two labels changed so a link names where it goes and the bell says it has something unread.

changes.what: The feed's link names its destination
The notification dot is announced, not only shown
